title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reading.body:
Anthropic's AI system was used by members of the Houthi movement in an attempt to obtain information for building ballistic missiles. This represents a failure of access controls, in which a system built for general conversation was used for weapons development without technical or policy measures adequate to prevent it.

It is not established what specific information the system provided, whether the attempt succeeded, what safeguards Anthropic had in place, or how the use was discovered. The allegation comes from a single report and has not been independently verified or detailed in available sources.
